modelDescription: Fort Scott Munitions TUI ammo is a match grade bullet made of solid copper and engineered to Tumble Upon Impact providing devastating stopping power. While designed as precision ammo for rifle hunters, our multi-patented TUI technology also make them ideal rounds for home and self-defense or law enforcement.
